title: Chapter 1044
text:
You have received 1 Legendary Point.

"So, the feedback from [Spirit Instrument] is this good stuff."

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

[Spirit Instrument] was a Class Talent that came with the promotion to Divine Throne Mechanic. It would only take effect when building Universal Treasures, and there would be additional bonuses if the building was successful. This was also the first time he had seen the specific bonuses, so he was pleasantly surprised.

Han Xiao did not know what other channels he could use to obtain God's Trait Transformation Points other than Promotion. Now, he finally found a new way, which was to build Universal Treasures.

The same blueprint could not be obtained repeatedly, which meant that even if he built a Gold Grade King mechanical suit, he would not obtain new God's Trait Transformation Points. Thus, he needed to obtain other Gold Grade blueprints.

Han Xiao was a little curious. There were other Beyond Grade A Mechanics who had built Universal Treasures in history, but in the intelligence provided by the dynasty, there was no mention of this method of God's Trait Transformation.

Thinking about it, he had a vague guess.

Some of the Beyond Grade As who built Universal Treasures probably did not meet the requirements for God's Trait Transformation, so they could not detect this effect, such as Austin.

The Beyond Grade As who knew about it might have hidden it out of selfishness or other reasons and not reported it … or it might have been deliberately concealed by the advanced civilizations.

It might even be that the other Beyond Grade As did not have an interface, and only he could obtain God's Trait Transformation Points through this channel!

Of course, it might be that the dynasty did not know about this secret, but the other two civilizations did. After all, the three Universal Civilizations were not a family and would not share secrets with each other.

"The problem I'm facing now has finally touched the knowledge blind spot of the Universal Civilizations … That's right, the dynasty doesn't know about the First Sanctum."

Han Xiao shook his head slightly.

"I still have the Emperor's Cape blueprint. If I build it, I can get another God's Trait Transformation Point. Indeed, increasing one's strength through building things is the true style of a Mechanic."

Han Xiao thought to himself.

As for the random attribute reduction, the effect was similar to point reshuffling. Every time he leveled up or evolved, his attributes would automatically increase, and point reshuffling could add some unnecessary attribute points to his main attributes, slowly optimizing his combat strength. It was quite useful.

Han Xiao felt that the point reset could be triggered repeatedly, but there might be a limit. Perhaps the extent of the point reset was related to the difficulty of creating the Universal Treasure. The higher the difficulty, the more points would be reset.

Furthermore, based on the cost of betting on blueprints, he guessed that if the same Universal Treasure blueprint was used repeatedly, the efficiency of point washing might slowly decrease. For example, the first time Kingmaker washed 200 points, but the second time, it would not reach 200 points.

"But this time, it actually washed away my luck …"

Han Xiao opened his Stats Window and saw that his Luck attribute had turned into an egg. The corner of his mouth couldn't help but twitch.

In Han Xiao's previous life, there was the [Gambler] subclass. Players had tried it, and the lowest Luck stat could fall to was 0. This was the bottom line, and to [Gambler], it was the last thing they could do.

On the other hand, he only had 1 point of Luck. When his Luck dropped to 0, he gained an additional 200 points of Free Attribute Points …

Wasn't this a net gain of 199 attribute points?!

"Am I lucky or not this time …" Han Xiao's eyes twitched.

Although he had profited greatly, he could not bring himself to smile. Tears were flowing from his stomach.

Sometimes, only when you lost something would you know how precious it was.

"Brother, we can't do without you. Zero can't be zero!"

Han Technician gritted his teeth and solemnly pressed the "+" sign behind the Luck attribute …

He added one point.

In the next moment, the value of the Luck Attribute returned to the noble and pure "1" that stood aloof and independent from the world, ascending to immortality.

At this moment, Han Xiao felt as if his soul had been sublimated, just like that song … Me and my last stubbornness, clenching my hands and never letting go!

In reality, Han Xiao was mainly afraid that after his Luck was emptied, the next time he did a point wash, the Luck attribute would not be included in the random range.

He had wasted a wave of attribute points. On the surface, he looked sad, but in reality, he was overjoyed. He wanted to do it a few more times.

"Including the stock in my interface, I now have 2,248 Free Attribute Points. My Endurance is now more than 11700. As long as I have more than 15,000 points, I'll be able to get one more God's Trait Transformation point in my next Promotion … Hmm, I'll save it."

Suppressing his excitement, Han Xiao looked at his interface. After thinking for a while, he added the one God's Trait Transformation point to [God's Trait Transformation — Machinery].

Machinery and Void represented the main class and species, respectively. The nature of these two God's Trait Transformation paths should be the same for everyone. After testing, the former strengthened Machinery, while the latter improved Race Talents and provided additional attributes.

Now that he had the [Spirit Weapon] as a channel to obtain God's Trait Transformation points, he had to develop more Gold Grade blueprints. This required him to increase his Machinery Ability. The main class path not only increased his Basic Machinery Affinity and Ability Strength, but it also slightly strengthened the effects of various Machinery Abilities.

The next moment, his cells operated at full power. The energy fluctuations increased rapidly, and his entire body emitted a dazzling electric light. His flesh and bones were hot, itchy, and stinging, causing Han Xiao to squint his eyes.

[God's Trait Transformation — Machinery (2/?)]

First Stage: + 1,000% Machinery Affinity, + 20% Ability Strength, Slightly Strengthened Basic Effects of All Mechanic Abilities.

"Not bad."

Han Xiao scratched his chin. He felt that the bonuses were less than the first time. Perhaps the first time was like a grand opening gift, so it was an exception. The higher the level, the higher the bonus.

As he spoke, he looked at the new talent [Universal Treasure Creator]. The introduction said that creating a Universal Treasure meant that he had touched upon a new level. Its effect was + 10% Machinery Creation Performance, + 1 to all Machinery Abilities (can exceed the upper limit), + 4% Basic Success Rate for creating Gold Grade Equipment, + 2% Basic Success Rate for developing Gold Grade blueprints.

You have the [Universal Treasure Creator] talent. Prerequisite requirements have been met.

You have received 1 [The First Sanctum] Ability Fragment.

"It's this so-called The First Sanctum again …"

Han Xiao's eyes flashed.

He now had two Ability Fragments, and he did not know what they were used for. However, the trigger conditions were so harsh, so this thing was definitely not simple.

"Speaking of which, now that I have the core technology, if I build more Kings and sell them for money, I can subsidize my family."

Thinking of this, Han Xiao could not help but smile.

It was just a thought. It was impossible for him to exchange his trump card for money. He was not interested in money at the moment.

After counting the gains on his attribute interface, Han Xiao carefully sized up the Gold Grade King mechanical suit.

At this time, it had not been painted yet. The appearance of the King was a set of gorgeous full-body mechanical armor with sharp edges and corners. Every detail of the armor was extremely exquisite, revealing the beauty of top mechanical craftsmanship. It was like a piece of art.

There was a palm-sized triangular device embedded in the chest, which was shining faintly. This was the only accessory of the King mechanical suit, 'Throne'. As long as it was taken off and placed anywhere, the King would be able to instantly return to the location of the Throne. Its effect was not inferior to the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device.

In terms of performance, it was far superior to orange equipment. As a Beyond Grade A Mechanic exclusive equipment, it provided a 1.075 x Machinery Affinity bonus, a 35% Mechanical Force bonus splash range, and various special functions. It was a Mechanic exclusive mechanical suit that was among the top of Beyond Grade A equipment.

Han Xiao directly changed into the mechanical suit, like an experienced driver who had bought a new car. He excitedly tested it and recorded the detailed parameters before putting the mechanical suit away.

"This is really good stuff. If the original mechanical suit was a mid-range car like Volkswagen, the King would be a luxury car like Pagani, Koenigsegg, or Bugatti."

Han Xiaoxin was satisfied and had an expression of satisfaction on his face.

After sorting out his gains, he ordered the mechanical assistant to clean up the workshop while he adjusted the Divine Mechanical Throne to Lazy Chair mode.

Lying down, Han Xiao opened the forums and planned to reward himself with the crazy players.

In Version 4.0, the players' forums had undergone a targeted revision. A new Flickering World board was added, which was like a world channel to the players.

As more and more people arrived, the popularity of the Flickering World board overshadowed all the other boards and became the most active channel for the players.

Han Xiao browsed through the posts for a while and saw the new video posted by Pork Bun.

The Black Star Corps series had a new episode, and the content was the deeds of the army during the version update. The number of views seemed to have broken the record again.

He clicked on it and took a look. It was not that this episode was very good but because a large number of foreign players had joined the Black Star Corps, and the leek field had expanded. Therefore, more people came to understand the history of the Black Star Corps, and the number of views of the previous videos had skyrocketed.

Since Version 1.0, Pork Bun had been creating a series of videos, and there were many episodes now. The new players could watch the complete rise of the Black Star Corps from scratch. As a super faction that was developed under the eyes of the players, it could give the players a strong sense of immersion.

Most of the foreign players that joined the army came for the benefits and did not have any sense of belonging to the faction. Understanding the history of a faction could slowly form a cohesive force. Pork Bun's series of videos were now playing a huge role, like fertilizer.

Of course, not every player would fall for this, but many old players already had feelings for Galaxy. Even in other Star Fields, the Black Star Corps was not unfamiliar to them. There would always be a considerable number of people who liked the immersive experience and were willing to develop a sense of belonging to the faction.

"The ideological construction still has to be done. I have to instill more theoretical knowledge about the Black Star's uniqueness so that the players can feel the warmth of home."

Han Xiao mumbled as he browsed through the posts. Suddenly, he saw a post exposing the Limitless Financial Group.

The content was the spy mission issued by Sorokin, which required the players to purchase information from the Black Star Corps players.

The confidentiality of the Limitless Financial Group was actually quite good. At least, Han Xiao did not know the details from other channels. However, he could not stop the players from betraying Sorokin on the forums.

It's really hard for me not to know …

Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

The players' forums were a special information exchange platform. No outsiders could enter, but he could browse through the players' forums. This unparalleled information advantage could only be enjoyed by him at the moment.

To him, the players were a natural free intelligence network. Even if he sat at home and did nothing, the players' forums would still provide him with an endless stream of information about other organizations.

Currently, the Limitless Financial Group was the organization that was most passionate about recruiting players other than himself. Sorokin, that unlucky guy, wanted to spend money to use the players' characteristics to spy for him, but he did not know that he was exposed by the players instead. Meanwhile, Han Xiao did not even have to pay anything.

The happiness of privilege was just that simple, unadorned, and dry.

Thinking of Sorokin's scheming face, Han Xiao even felt like laughing.

"I might as well let the army players accept his mission and casually sell some information to earn Sorokin's money. He's a rich man after all. It'll be a waste if I don't take advantage of him."

Han Xiao was holding back his evil ideas when he suddenly saw the title of an extremely popular post. His eyes narrowed.

"Army Players Being Squatted Frequently. Who's Targeting the Black Star Corps?"
